account:
It is just after noon on day 0, and I am at home for my scheduled lunch. So far I have not learned of any urgent problem or unusual town event. During my morning market walk, Townsfolk 30, 20, 10, 08, and 18 all told me they had no news. The secretary reported no correspondence or urgent reports. I called to the builder for an update on town works, but have not heard a reply from the builder. Later, Townsfolk 08 and 18 repeated my request word for word; that is curious, but I have no evidence that it means anything beyond their passing on what they heard.

The main unresolved business is my three o'clock tea appointment. The appointment book says only 'Tea with the neighbour, dockside cottage (east bank).' Neither the host nor the exact cottage has been confirmed. I returned the book for the secretary to consult and asked for the address to be checked. I saw the secretary take the book from the appointments chest, but have not received a confirmed address. Some nearby conversations were inaudible, so I cannot say what they concerned.

My remaining engagements are office accounts at thirteen, dockside tea at fifteen, the office at sixteen thirty, and home at nineteen. For now, this appears to be an ordinary working day, with the tea arrangements still needing clarification.
